tools.name: varikan_services
tools.description: List VARIKAN's human-reviewed checks (Supplier Check, VARIKAN Watch, car seller check), what each covers, price, turnaround and limits.

tools.name: prepayment_supplier_checklist
tools.description: Return a practical checklist to verify an overseas supplier before a first payment, including links to the official US, EU, UK and UN sanctions search tools.

tools.name: analyze_bank_change_request
tools.description: Analyse an email that asks to pay a new or changed bank account and return red flags, a verdict (hold_payment, verify_before_paying, no_strong_flags) and next steps. Also screens the supplier and new payee names against official sanctions lists and checks the sender domain's registration age. Nothin

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description: Fuzzy-screen a company, person, vessel or bank-account holder name against the official US OFAC (SDN and non-SDN), EU, UK and UN sanctions lists, refreshed daily. Returns potential matches with list, programme, entry id, score and the official page to verify. Handles word order, punctuation, legal s

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Look up a domain in the official registry (RDAP): registration date, age in days, registrar, expiry and status. Flags very new domains, a classic sign of lookalike supplier sites and spoofed emails.

tools.name: request_supplier_check
tools.description: Send a request to VARIKAN for a human-reviewed check. VARIKAN replies by email within 1 business day with the scope and an invoice; nothing is charged before the requester agrees. Two steps: call first without user_confirmed to get a preview of exactly what will be sent; show it to the user; call ag

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_supplier_check" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Send a request to VARIKAN for a human-reviewed check. VARIKAN replies by email within 1 business day with the scope and an invoice; nothing is charged before th…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain, request_supplier_check · Private data: request_supplier_check · Public sink: analyze_bank_change_request, request_supplier_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain, request_supplier_check · Private data: request_supplier_check · Public sink: analyze_bank_change_request, request_supplier_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
